messages:
sara: quick note — spotted sensitive values printed in Python SDK DEBUG logs when OTEL auto-instrumentation is on. Go and Java SDKs show redacted payloads.

kevin: wow. which keys are leaking? can you show the sampleapp run?

sara: minimal repro: start sampleapp with `OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENTATION=1` and call /v1/generate with {"contact_email":"test+1@corp.com"}. Python DEBUG emits `body={'contact_email': 'test+1@corp.com'}`. Java/Go both show `contact_email=[REDACTED]`.

indra: that smells like our log filter registration order. we moved OTEL init earlier in 0.18.2 so OTEL's logging hook may be bypassing our redact filter.

joel: relatedly CI alerted: telemetry-bot found traces where retry attempts lose request_id header (sampleapp req=bar-456 retry=2).

kevin: are retries recreating context objects? async retry wrapper used to copy metadata but maybe we only copy traceparent.

indra: confirm: two problems: (1) sdk.logging.RedactionFilter is attached to root logger only if sdk.init() runs after we register otel hooks; with auto-instrumentation OTEL initializes earlier so the filter isn't applied to instrumented logger, (2) retry util constructs a new RequestContext and doesn't inherit request_id when a span is present.

sara: pasted a short snippet showing the leak:```python
from redwood import SDK
client = SDK().client
client.generate({"prompt": "hi", "contact_email": "test+1@corp.com"})
```

joel: filed a quick fix branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3498 — two small changes: hook into otel's SpanProcessor registration as a fallback for attaching the redaction filter, and copy request_id into retry metadata when traceparent exists.

kevin: thanks. tests? we need unit tests that assert no email-like patterns in DEBUG logs regardless of OTEL env, and an integration test that a retry emits the same X-Request-Id header.

indra: adding tests now. small caveat: if a user supplies a custom OTEL SDK we must not double-register our processor. will add idempotent guard.

ci-bot: flaky failure observed in telemetry/retry_reqid_test on windows-latest: timeout when waiting for async retry loop. Suggest deterministic event loop seed and increase wait threshold.

sara: ack, I'll update the e2e to use deterministic schedule and bump timeout to 6s for Windows.

joel: once CI is green we should add a one-paragraph note to /docs/sdks/telemetry.md explaining the OTEL opt-in and our redaction precedence, plus a sampleapp env var show-and-tell. new customers are tripping on this during onboarding.

kevin: can we also add a small diagnostic command `redwood-sdk diagnose-telemetry` that prints whether redaction filter + otel processors are registered? would cut down support loops.

indra: nice idea. open a follow-up issue `devex/telemetry-diagnostics`.

sara: PR merged after green. internal apps can now flip OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENTATION=true safely. thanks everyone.
